[Story]
At a family gathering, everyone is dividing a pile of gifts. Dad says to his son, Xiao Ming, "There are 50 gifts here, most of them are toys, some are clothes, but there are hardly any books." Xiao Ming checks and finds that there are 10 pieces of clothing.

[Question]
How many dolls does Xiao Ming estimate before checking?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before checking, Xiao Ming estimates there are 50 dolls.
B. Before checking, Xiao Ming estimates there are 49 dolls.
C. Before checking, Xiao Ming estimates there are 45 dolls.
D. Before checking, Xiao Ming estimates there are 20 dolls.
